name: Fresh grind, rare judge
goal: {{task}} Done when every phase in {{phase-checklist}} has passed the judge and `{{test-command}}` passes.

template.title: Fresh grind, rare judge
template.summary: A fast builder grinds each phase against the tests; an expensive judge runs only at phase boundaries, against a phase checklist.
template.whenToUse: Cheap iteration most steps, an expensive critic at phase boundaries: long work splits into phases that tests can drive but only judgment can sign off.
template.notFor: Short tasks with one phase (use grind-loop or review-gate), or work where the tests cannot drive any of the steps.

slots.ask: What should be built or changed? One or two sentences a builder can act on.
slots.example: Migrate the storage layer in src/storage/ from callbacks to async/await, one module per phase.

slots.ask: Which file lists the phases, each with what the judge checks at its boundary?

description: An inner grind loop, a fast builder against the tests, runs inside an outer judgment loop. Only when the tests pass does a frontier judge review the phase against the phase checklist: fail returns to the builder to fix the phase, next-phase returns it to start the next one, and pass ends the run. Both loops are budgeted.

nodes.name: Builder
nodes.brief: Work through the current phase of {{phase-checklist}} until `{{test-command}}` passes; one phase at a time, never ahead. On a failing test, start from its output; after a judge review, start from PHASE-REVIEW.md. Report which phase you are on and what changed.
inputs: test output or PHASE-REVIEW.md (from round 1 on)
outputs: the change for this phase, with tests
CHANGES.md: the phase and what changed

check.pass: exit code 0 and no test skipped

nodes.name: Phase judge
nodes.description: Runs only at phase boundaries: after the tests pass.
nodes.brief: Judge the finished phase against its entry in {{phase-checklist}}, citing file and line for each item. Emit fail with findings when the phase is not done, next-phase when it is and phases remain, and pass when the last phase is done. You judge; you do not fix.
inputs: diff since the last phase boundary
the repository as the change leaves it, read-only
outputs: PHASE-REVIEW.md: the phase item by item and a verdict line

evidence: diff since the last phase boundary
the repository as the change leaves it, read-only

bar.name: Phase checklist
bar.acceptance: Every phase in {{phase-checklist}} is signed off by the judge with evidence, and `{{test-command}}` exits 0.
